suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require documented endometriosis preceding separately diagnosed ovarian cancer. Treat as population-level association/risk evidence, with strongest histologic signal for endometrioid/clear-cell disease; do not claim individual causation. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
